name.hi: एलआईसी गोल्डन जुबली छात्रवृत्ति 2026 (सामान्य, 12वीं के बाद)

summary.en: ₹20,000-₹50,000 a year for first-year degree, diploma or ITI students from families earning up to ₹4.5 lakh who scored 60%+ in 12th.

text.en: Passed 12th with at least 60% in 2024, 2025 or 2026

source.quote: All candidates who have passed Class XII exam (or its equivalent) with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA grade in the Academic Year 2023-24/2024-25/2025-26

text.en: Admitted to the first year of a course in 2026-27

source.quote: Have taken admission in the academic year 2026-27 for pursuing first year degree course
Have parents/guardian with an annual income (from all sources) not exceeding Rs.4,50,000/- per annum.

text.en: Not a correspondence, part-time or open-university course

source.quote: Correspondence or Part Time (Evening or Night Classes) and/or through Open Universities are not eligible for Scholarship.

text.en: Not already receiving a scholarship from another trust (government scholarships are allowed)

source.quote: Candidates who are already receiving Scholarship from other Trust / Institution will not be considered for LIC GJF Scholarship.

text.en: Income certificate from a revenue authority (Tahsildar etc.) for the previous financial year

source.quote: Candidates are required to submit Income certificate issued by competent Revenue Authorities of the State
Physical document verification is conducted by Divisional Officials to authenticate marks and income.
copy of cancelled cheque with name of beneficiary is compulsory

label.en: Last date for the online application

source.quote: Last date of submission of Online Application is: 30.09.2026

notes: The Special Scholarship (after 10th, ₹15,000/year) is a separate track; not in this pack.
Not for post-graduation; integrated UG+PG courses are covered (page text).
Selection is merit-based per LIC division: meeting the criteria does not mean selection.
The 2026 deadline (30.09.2026) has passed as of 2026-10-03.
